2026-11-26.title: Jeremiah Johnson
2026-11-26.overview: While slowly adapting to the grueling life of a mountain man in the Rocky Mountains, Jeremiah Johnson encounters the Crow and Flathead tribes as well as hunters, trappers and settlers, all of whom call these mountains home.

2026-11-26.title: The Salvation
2026-11-26.overview: In 1870s America, a peaceful American settler kills his family's murderer which unleashes the fury of a notorious gang leader. His cowardly fellow townspeople then betray him, forcing him to hunt down the outlaws alone.

2026-11-26.title: City Slickers
2026-11-26.overview: Three New York businessmen decide to take a "Wild West" vacation that turns out not to be the relaxing vacation they had envisioned.

2026-11-26.title: Unforgiven
2026-11-26.overview: William Munny is a retired, once-ruthless killer turned gentle widower and hog farmer. Joined by his former partner and a cocky greenhorn, he takes on a corrupt sheriff.

2026-11-26.title: Sukiyaki Western Django
2026-11-26.overview: A nameless gunfighter arrives in a town ripped apart by rival gangs and, though courted by both to join, chooses his own path.

2026-11-26.title: Dances with Wolves
2026-11-26.overview: Wounded Civil War soldier John Dunbar tries to commit suicide—and becomes a hero instead. As a reward, he's assigned to his dream post, a remote junction on the Western frontier, and soon makes unlikely friends with the local Sioux tribe.

2026-11-26.title: Man of the East
2026-11-26.overview: By his dying father's last wish Joe is sent to the Wild West to become a real guy. The dreamy young man despises guns and fights likes poems and prefers bicycles to horses. Now his three teachers footpads all of them shall teach him otherwise. When it turns out that the government has been using the bank as a hiding place for illegally detained political prisoners -- who are freed by the blast -- Miranda becomes a revolutionary hero against his will.

2026-11-26.overview: Three of the original five "young guns" — Billy the Kid, Jose Chavez y Chavez, and Doc Scurlock — return in Young Guns, Part 2, which is the story of Billy the Kid and his race to safety in Old Mexico while being trailed by a group of government agents led by Pat Garrett.

2026-11-26.title: The Warrior's Way
2026-11-26.overview: A warrior-assassin is forced to hide in a small town in the American Badlands after refusing a mission.

2026-11-26.title: The Hateful Eight
2026-11-26.overview: Bounty hunters seek shelter from a raging blizzard and get caught up in a plot of betrayal and deception.
